name: Welcome Angler
description: Prove yourself by catching a handful of fish, any will do.

name: Catfish Trouble
description: The local catfish have been causing a ruckus. Catch a few to thin them out.

name: Ink in the Water
description: Squid keep stealing bait off the docks. Catch a couple to put a stop to it.

name: Into the Bog
description: Get a feel for the swamp by catching whatever crosses your line.

name: Chasing Lights
description: Strange lights have been dancing over the bog at night. Catch one if you can.

name: Rainbow Hunt
description: Bring me a couple of rainbow trout and I'll make it worth your while.

name: The Lake Serpent
description: Locals swear something huge lives in the deepest part of the lake. Prove it.

name: The River Monster
description: Rumor has it a monstrous eel lurks in the river depths. Catch it for a bounty.

name: Slippery Company
description: The river otterfish are playful but hard to pin down. See how many you can catch.

name: Shoreline Collector
description: Collect a few uncommon catches from along the coast.

name: Reef Rarities
description: The reef holds some truly impressive catches. Bring me a couple of the best ones.

name: Braving the Ice
description: Not many anglers make it out here. Show me you can handle the cold.

name: Hatchling of the Glacier
description: Legends speak of tiny wyrms born from the glacier itself. Find one.

name: Open Water Rarities
description: The open ocean holds rare treasures. Bring me proof of your skill.

name: Sunken Fortune
description: I've heard tales of an old chest still sitting on the ocean floor. Bring it to me.

name: Into the Heat
description: These waters are dangerous but full of life. Bring me a few uncommon specimens.

name: Reborn From Ash
description: There have been sightings of a koi wreathed in flame near the vents. I need to study one.

name: Light in the Dark
description: I need an anglerfish specimen for my research.

name: Bigger Than Giant
description: There are rumors of a squid even larger than the giant squid down here. Find it.

name: The Abyssal King
description: Only the bravest anglers dare hunt the Leviathan King. Will you be the one?

name: Something Older
description: There are things down here older than the Leviathan King itself. Find the Forgotten One, if you dare.

name: Above the Clouds
description: Welcome to the sky lake. Not many make it this far. Catch a few fish to celebrate.

name: Fallen Star
description: Legends tell of a creature that fell from the stars and now swims among the clouds. Find it.
